title: Roast Duck with Orange
subtitle: Whole roast duck with a bitter orange glaze
excerpt: Whole duck roasted until the skin is deep mahogany and crackling-crisp, glazed with a bitter orange sauce made from the pan drippings. The fat renders slowly; pricking the skin before roasting is the key to crispness.

recipe.sourceNotes: Duck with orange is associated primarily with the French dish canard a l'orange, but the pairing of fatty duck or goose with acidic citrus appears across medieval and Renaissance European cooking. The classic French version uses Seville orange juice and the pan fond to make a brown sauce; British versions tend to be simpler with the glaze applied during the final stage of roasting. Duck fat from the roasting tin is among the best cooking fats there is.

recipeTools.notes: Large roasting tin with a rack.

content.text: Duck must be pricked all over with a skewer or fork before roasting, particularly on the thighs and breast, so the fat can render out. Do not prick down into the meat, just the skin. Pour off the fat every 30 minutes during roasting; it will be substantial and you should collect and save it. The orange glaze goes on in the last 20 minutes so it caramelises rather than burns.
The day before if possible: prick the duck skin all over with a skewer. Rub with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry the skin. Take out 1 hour before cooking.
Heat the oven to 200 C / fan 180 C / gas 6. Put the garlic, thyme, and a halved orange inside the duck cavity. Season with pepper and place breast-side up on a rack in the tin. Roast for 30 minutes.
Carefully pour off the fat into a bowl. Reduce the oven to 180 C / fan 160 C / gas 4. Continue roasting for 40 minutes, pouring off fat again at 20 minutes.

Mix the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, and juice of the remaining orange. Brush generously over the duck. Roast for a final 20 to 25 minutes, brushing once more halfway through, until the skin is deep amber and crisp. Rest for 15 minutes.
Pour off excess fat from the tin, add the stock and simmer on the hob for 5 minutes, scraping the pan. Add any remaining glaze mixture and reduce to a sauce. Serve the duck with the sauce.
